keyPoints.en: LED: long leg anode (+), flat side cathode (−); always use a series resistor.
keyPoints.bm: LED: kaki panjang anod (+), sisi rata katod (−); sentiasa gunakan perintang bersiri.

keyPoints.en: LDR resistance falls as light increases. Systems: input → process → output.
keyPoints.bm: Rintangan LDR berkurang apabila cahaya bertambah. Sistem: input → proses → output.

keyPoints.en: Series: one path, same current, voltage shared, R = R₁ + R₂ + …; one fails → all off.
keyPoints.bm: Bersiri: satu laluan, arus sama, voltan dikongsi, R = R₁ + R₂ + …; satu rosak → semua padam.

keyPoints.en: Parallel: branches, same voltage each, current splits; others stay on.
keyPoints.bm: Selari: bercabang, voltan sama setiap cabang, arus terbahagi; yang lain kekal menyala.

keyPoints.en: V = I × R. LED resistor: R = (Vsupply − VLED) ÷ I, e.g. (9 − 2) ÷ 0.02 = 350 Ω.
keyPoints.bm: V = I × R. Perintang LED: R = (Vbekalan − VLED) ÷ I, cth. (9 − 2) ÷ 0.02 = 350 Ω.

keyPoints.en: Colour code: brown-black-red = 1, 0, ×100 = 1 kΩ. Choose the next standard value up.
keyPoints.bm: Kod warna: perang-hitam-merah = 1, 0, ×100 = 1 kΩ. Pilih nilai piawai seterusnya yang lebih tinggi.

tip.en: Convert mA to A before using Ohm's law.
tip.bm: Tukar mA kepada A sebelum menggunakan hukum Ohm.
